improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.
Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.
improve.coach: 42% overall, same lately. Our next project.

improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.
Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't.
When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes.
improve.coach: 37% overall, 20% in your last five. Better every week.

improve.title: On-ball involvement
tips: Talk. Call for it early so the passer knows where you'll be.
Show for it. Move into the passing lane and ask for the ball instead of hiding behind your marker.
Move after you pass. A pass-and-move player is always an option.
improve.coach: Consistent at 37%. Targeted practice will help.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: The goal was open and you walked right through the door. 47% consistency. Bankable.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: You saw passes other folks didn't even know existed. 42% of matches. Build around it.
